abstractEnglish: We prove a uniform upper bound for inverse-first-power integral means of normalized univalent disk maps with exponent strictly below 1/4. Consequently, the bounded universal integral-means spectrum satisfies $`B_b(-1)\lt 1/4`$, disproving Kraetzer's conjectured spectrum at p = −1.
titleEn: A strict inverse-first-power bound for univalent functions
titleZh: 单叶函数的严格逆一次幂界
